shortDescription: MathGPT is an AI-powered math solver designed to assist students across various educational levels. It offers solutions for algebra, calculus, physics, and more. Users can upload homework in different formats and receive step-by-step solutions, video explanations, and interactive quizzes. Ideal for students struggling with complex math concepts, MathGPT acts as a personal tutor, enhancing understanding and confidence in tackling difficult subjects.
